# Release Draft: v1.2.0

Tag: v1.2.0
Date: 2025-11-05

Summary
-------
This release focuses on pagination consistency across the app, profile persistence fixes, supplier/customer UX improvements, and various backend fixes and test stabilizations.

Highlights
----------
- Standardized server-side pagination for Users, Purchases, Suppliers (aggregates) and Products.
- Fixed Product listing bug where pages showed empty results when the client sliced already-paged data.
- Profile settings: phone is now returned by `GET /api/auth/me` and saved by `PUT /api/auth/me`.
- Customer disabled flow implemented and integrated into POS (disabled customers cannot be selected).
- Supplier phone display corrected and editing behavior improved.
- Moved inline pill/toggle styles to CSS classes for consistent theming.

How to verify
-------------
1. Start backend and frontend dev servers. Create enough items to exceed page sizes and confirm navigation through pages.
2. Update your profile and confirm phone number persists and displays after reload.
3. Disable a customer and confirm they are not selectable in POS suggestions.

Notes for release
-----------------
- This is a draft release — please review and adjust changelog entries as needed.
- Recommended release tag: `v1.2.0` (annotated tag created locally). Push tags and create a GitHub release (or use GH CLI).
